## sminer finding list

List findings, highest score first

### Synopsis

List findings, highest score first, one per line:

  ID  STATUS  REMEDY  OCCURRENCES  SESSIONS  SCORE  TITLE

No findings is not an error: the command prints nothing and exits 0.

```
sminer finding list [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  sminer finding list
  sminer finding list --status accepted
  sminer finding list --json | jq -r '.[] | select(.remedy == "hook") | .id'
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help            help for list
      --status string   open, accepted, dismissed or all (default "open")
```
